cohort: Infants (114 twins and 115 singletons) born between 34 and 35 weeks of gestation at Sheba Medical Center in 2008.
finding: Despite being born smaller and more SGA, twins are at a lower risk of requiring medical intervention in the immediate neonatal period compared with singletons.
mod_finding: A significant proportion of late preterm births is iatrogenic, with only 44% of all deliveries being spontaneous.
birth_weight: Twins were born lighter, and 31.9% of twins were small for gestational age (SGA).
